## Additional Qwen2-VL and InternVL attribution boundaries

Qwen2-VL host compatibility: the FP16 eager-score compatibility function in `migration_sources/current_archive/releases/qwen_minimal_peer_reuse_r6_20261001/source/fp16_eager_stability.py` follows the Transformers v4.57.6 Qwen2-VL eager-attention interface, with the documented FP32 QK accumulation adaptation. The corresponding fixed upstream source is https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v4.57.6/src/transformers/models/qwen2_vl/modeling_qwen2_vl.py (Git blob `269f37492ad6375ac610463cc58a382700c94d62`, header lines 1–19 and eager-attention lines 295–318). Applicable Qwen2-VL-derived host portions retain Apache-2.0 and the original notice: “Copyright 2024 The Qwen team, Alibaba Group and the HuggingFace Inc. team. All rights reserved.” The complete original header, including the upstream GPT-NeoX/OPT attribution, is preserved in `third_party/transformers/QWEN2VL_COPYRIGHT_HEADER.txt`; the full Apache-2.0 license is `third_party/transformers/LICENSE`. The CLIP notice applies to CLIP-derived portions and does not replace this Qwen2-VL attribution. No whole-project relicensing is asserted.

SmolVLM IPCV reference: `smol_ipcv_port.py` identifies the IPCV InternVL implementation as its crop-batch numerical reference. The pinned source https://github.com/Perkzi/IPCV/blob/29726f044f0f9c0c2be4eb0005888ddeb5fa188e/InternVL2/InternVL2_IPCV/modeling_intern_vit_sparse_IPCV.py (Git blob `94784fefff3ec8e7698ace250b7c46f0eb8928f1`) carries the original file-level notice “Copyright (c) 2024 OpenGVLab” and “Licensed under The MIT License”. That header is preserved in `third_party/ipcv/INTERNVL_COPYRIGHT_HEADER.txt`. The original InternVL MIT license text, with its separate “Copyright (c) 2023 OpenGVLab” notice, is provided in `third_party/ipcv/INTERNVL_MIT_LICENSE`, retrieved from the pinned official OpenGVLab source recorded in `sources/ADDITIONAL_COMPONENT_NOTICE_PROVENANCE.json`. IPCV's root Apache-2.0 license remains applicable to its corresponding additions; it does not replace or relicense underlying InternVL MIT portions. The two copyright years are retained exactly as their separate upstream sources provide them. This attribution notice does not assert numerical equivalence or scientific acceptance.
